    Ported from TauCeti (TauCeti.CategoryTheory.EqToHom, commit 580b6f9d5, Apache 2.0).

    Transporting categorical morphisms along object equalities #

    This file provides general lemmas for removing and rearranging the conjugations by eqToHom that arise when categorical objects are identified propositionally. They apply in an arbitrary category and avoid exposing the definitional equality of the objects being transported.

    Main results #

    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.eqToHom_conjugate_cancel: transporting a morphism and then transporting it back leaves it unchanged.
    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.eqToHom_conjugate_eq_id, LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.eqToHom_conjugate_eq_comp and LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.eqToHom_conjugate_add: transporting an identity, a composite or a sum gives the identity, the composite of the transports or the sum of the transports.
    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.eqToHom_conjugate_square: conjugating every edge preserves and reflects commutativity of a square.
    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.eq_of_eqToHom_conjugate: two morphisms with equal conjugates are equal.
    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.eqToHom_conjugate_vertical_square_of_horizontal_square: commutativity with conjugated horizontal edges gives commutativity after moving the conjugations to the vertical edges.
    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.eqToHom_eq_iso_hom_map_eqToHom: transport along an index equality is conjugate, through identifications Y i ≅ F.obj (X i), to the image under a functor F of the transport.
    • CategoryTheory.Functor.map_heq: a functor sends morphisms which agree up to equalities of their endpoints to morphisms which agree in the same way.

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.eqToHom_conjugate_cancel {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] {X X' Y Y' : C} (hX : X = X') (hY : Y = Y') (f : X' ⟶ Y') :
    CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.eqToHom ⋯) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.eqToHom hX) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f (CategoryTheory.eqToHom ⋯))) (CategoryTheory.eqToHom hY)) = f

    Transporting a morphism along object equalities and then back leaves it unchanged.

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.eqToHom_conjugate_eq_id {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] {X Y : C} (h : X = Y) (f : Y ⟶ Y) (hf : f = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id Y) :
    CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.eqToHom h) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f (CategoryTheory.eqToHom ⋯)) = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id X

    A transported identity is the identity: conjugating a morphism equal to 𝟙 Y by the object equality X = Y gives 𝟙 X.

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.eqToHom_conjugate_eq_comp {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] {X X' Y Y' Z Z' : C} (hX : X = X') (hY : Y = Y') (hZ : Z = Z') (f : X' ⟶ Z') (g : X' ⟶ Y') (h : Y' ⟶ Z') (hf : f = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g h) :
    CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.eqToHom hX) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f (CategoryTheory.eqToHom ⋯)) = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.eqToHom hX) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g (CategoryTheory.eqToHom ⋯))) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.eqToHom hY) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp h (CategoryTheory.eqToHom ⋯)))

    Transport distributes over composition: if f = g ≫ h, the transport of f is the composite of the transports of g and h.

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.eqToHom_conjugate_add {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] {X X' Y Y' : C} (hX : X = X') (hY : Y' = Y) {f g h : X' ⟶ Y'} (hfgh : f = g + h) :
    CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.eqToHom hX) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f (CategoryTheory.eqToHom hY)) = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.eqToHom hX) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g (CategoryTheory.eqToHom hY)) + CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.eqToHom hX) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp h (CategoryTheory.eqToHom hY))

    Transport is additive: in a preadditive category, if f = g + h, the transport of f is the sum of the transports of g and h.

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.eqToHom_conjugate_square {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] {X X' Y Y' Z Z' W W' : C} (hX : X = X') (hY : Y = Y') (hZ : Z = Z') (hW : W = W') (f : X' ⟶ Y') (g : Y' ⟶ Z') (f' : X' ⟶ W') (g' : W' ⟶ Z') :
    CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.eqToHom hX) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f (CategoryTheory.eqToHom ⋯))) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.eqToHom hY) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g (CategoryTheory.eqToHom ⋯))) = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.eqToHom hX) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f' (CategoryTheory.eqToHom ⋯))) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.eqToHom hW) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g' (CategoryTheory.eqToHom ⋯))) ↔ CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f g = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f' g'

    Conjugating a commuting square by object equalities leaves it commuting, and nothing else becomes commuting that way: the square of transported edges commutes exactly when the original one does.

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.eq_of_eqToHom_conjugate {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] {X X' Y Y' : C} (hX : X' = X) (hY : Y = Y') {f g : X ⟶ Y} (h : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.eqToHom hX) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f (CategoryTheory.eqToHom hY)) = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.eqToHom hX) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g (CategoryTheory.eqToHom hY))) :
    f = g

    Two morphisms conjugated to the same morphism are equal: conjugating back cancels, by LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.eqToHom_conjugate_cancel, on both sides at once.

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.eqToHom_conjugate_vertical_square_of_horizontal_square {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] {A A' B B' D D' E E' : C} (hA : A = A') (hB : B = B') (hD : D = D') (hE : E = E') (p : A' ⟶ B') (q : E' ⟶ D') (f : B ⟶ D) (g : A ⟶ E) (h : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.eqToHom hA) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp p (CategoryTheory.eqToHom ⋯))) f = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.eqToHom hE) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp q (CategoryTheory.eqToHom ⋯)))) :
    CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp p (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.eqToHom ⋯) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f (CategoryTheory.eqToHom hD))) = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.eqToHom ⋯) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g (CategoryTheory.eqToHom hE))) q

    A square with conjugated horizontal edges yields a square with conjugated vertical edges. The horizontal conjugations cancel from the conclusion, while the vertical edges acquire the corresponding conjugations.

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.eqToHom_eq_iso_hom_map_eqToHom {ι : Type u_1} {C : Type u_2} {D : Type u_3} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_2} C] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_2, u_3} D] (F : CategoryTheory.Functor C D) {X : ι → C} {Y : ι → D} (e : (i : ι) → Y i ≅ F.obj (X i)) {i j : ι} (h : i = j) :
    CategoryTheory.eqToHom ⋯ = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (e i).hom (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (F.map (CategoryTheory.eqToHom ⋯)) (e j).inv)

    Transport along an index equality commutes with identifications through a functor: given families X in C and Y in D with isomorphisms e i : Y i ≅ F.obj (X i), the transport Y i ⟶ Y j along i = j is the conjugate by e of the image under F of the transport X i ⟶ X j.

    source
    theorem CategoryTheory.Functor.map_heq {C : Type u_1} {D : Type u_2} [Category.{v_1, u_1} C] [Category.{v_2, u_2} D] (F : Functor C D) {X Y X' Y' : C} {f : X ⟶ Y} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} (hX : X = X') (hY : Y = Y') (h : f ≍ f') :
    F.map f ≍ F.map f'

    A functor sends morphisms which agree up to equalities of their endpoints to morphisms which agree in the same way.
